title: yaml.load() on bus message body allows arbitrary Python object instantiation
detail: src/aurora/aurora-portal/aurora_portal/telemetry_consumer.py:L17 calls yaml.load(message.body) with no SafeLoader; message.body arrives from the aurora.telemetry.tenant bus topic (produced by aurora-compute); a compromised or malicious producer can send YAML with arbitrary Python constructors, enabling remote code execution. Reclassified from CWE-20 to CWE-502.
owaspCategory: A08 Software and Data Integrity Failures
